body.x: CHEERO(www.cheero.net), an entrepreneurial department of a machinery parts manufacturing company, unveiled "Cheero Power Plus DANBOARD version mini" and "Cheero Power Plus 10400 DANBOARD version" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Cheero Power Plus DANBOARD version mini is a palm-sized, high-capacity external battery. One click on its mouth starts charging the device. Different eye colors (yellow, orange, red) indicate different battery level.Cheero Power Plus 10400 DANBOARD version is a rechargeable, multi-device compliant portable charger with dual USB output with a high capacity of 10400 mAh which can charge iPhone fully up to 5 times.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
